title: Owens takes an Eagles fullback out of a game
summary: Jeffrey Mishlove tells of Owens takes an Eagles fullback out of a game, about not stated at Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: middle of the game, Owens said, "I'm going to take out this player, told the reporter."

plain: Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher of psychic phenomena, tells of Ted Owens, a man who claimed psychic powers, at a game played by the Philadelphia Eagles, an American football team. According to Mishlove, Owens told a sports writer in the middle of the game that he was going to take out a certain player, and the Eagles fullback was then taken out, as the writer later reported in the newspaper. It is told as evidence that Owens could affect events with his mind.
